//! Throwaway check: SolidCraft's own reader opens a PCBCraft export and evaluates it.
use solidcraft_doc::Document;

#[test]
fn opens_pcbcraft_export() {
    let path = std::env::var("PCBCRAFT_FIXTURE").unwrap_or_else(|_| "/w/fixture.solidcraft".into());
    let bytes = std::fs::read(&path).expect("fixture");
    let doc: Document = solidcraft_io::read_design(&bytes).expect("read_design");
    println!("format={} components={} occurrences={} features={}", doc.format, doc.components.len(), doc.occurrences.len(), doc.features.len());
    let mut model = solidcraft_doc::Model::new();
    model.evaluate(&doc);
    for r in &model.results {
        assert!(r.error.is_none(), "feature {} failed: {:?}", r.id, r.error);
    }
    let state = solidcraft_doc::world_state(&doc, &model.state());
    let names: Vec<String> = state.bodies.iter().map(|b| b.name.clone()).collect();
    println!("bodies={names:?}");
    assert!(names.iter().any(|n| n == "Board"));
    assert!(names.iter().any(|n| n == "R1"));
}
